name: Syndicate Sabotage
summary: Myrokos Silentform sends you to Durnholde Keep to kill Lord Tomas. He expects Tomas's death to unsettle the Syndicate there.

sections.title: At Durnholde
sections.body: At Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills, Lord Tomas is the target Myrokos Silentform names. You are asked to kill him, then return to Myrokos.

sections.title: The Keep's Order
sections.body: Myrokos expects Tomas's death to leave the Syndicate thugs at Durnholde Keep without a leader and in disarray. He thanks you and may call on you again.

faq.answer: Myrokos Silentform asks you to find and kill Lord Tomas at Durnholde Keep, then return to him.
Lord Tomas is the target Myrokos names at Durnholde Keep.

faq.q: Why does Myrokos want Tomas dead?
faq.answer: Myrokos expects the Syndicate thugs at Durnholde Keep to fall into disarray without Tomas as their leader.
Lord Tomas is inside Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills.
